assumptions.description_zh: 当前使用临时粗略边界，所有面积指标需待正式数据到位后重新计算。
容积率、建筑密度、建筑高度、绿地率等法定控规指标未包含在征集资料包中。
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Official regulatory planning indicators are published

assumptions.description_zh: 地块权属、现有建筑产权等信息未提供。建筑更新策略为概念性建议。
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Official land ownership data becomes available

assumptions.description_zh: 三个层级范围均基于公告四至描述做矩形包络近似，实际边界可能不规则。
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Precise surveyed boundary CAD/GIS data is released

assumptions.description_zh: 建筑体量、高度、布局均为概念性设计表达，未经结构、消防等专业验证。
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Professional architectural design with structural review

assumptions.title_zh: 交通方案需专业模型验证
assumptions.description_zh: 交通组织方案为概念性框架，未经交通仿真模型验证。
